content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a NullPointerException (NPE) in the `LauncherMapper.printArgs()` method when handling arguments that were null or empty. The original implementation did not account for the possibility of null arguments being present in the configuration, leading to an attempt to access or manipulate these null values, which resulted in the NPE. The patch introduced checks to skip null or empty arguments when retrieving the main arguments, ensuring that only valid arguments are processed and returned.
